description: Defines builder classes for constructing RACH.indication PDUs and messages, including setting parameters like time domain, frequency domain, power, and adding preambles, as part of a 5G NR protocol implementation.

classes.name: rach_indication_pdu_builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing and setting parameters of RACH.indication PDUs.

classes.name: rach_indication_builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing RACH.indication messages, including adding PDUs and setting slot points.

methods.name: set_time_domain_parameters
methods.description: Sets symbol and slot indices for the RACH.indication PDU.

methods.name: set_frequency_domain_parameters
methods.description: Sets the RA (Random Access) index for the PDU.

methods.name: set_power_parameters
methods.description: Sets average RSSI and SNR values for the PDU, converting dB values to internal representation.

methods.name: add_preamble
methods.description: Adds a preamble with specified parameters to the PDU.

methods.name: set_slot_point
methods.description: Sets the slot point for the RACH.indication message.

methods.name: add_pdu
methods.description: Adds a new PDU to the RACH.indication message, configuring it with specified parameters.
